top_signals.title: The Deal: Ryan Howard on Sports Investing and MLB’s Labor Fight
top_signals.summary: "Five and a half years is the average career of a Major League Baseball player." On this episode of The Deal, Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly sit down to talk with Ryan Howard about salary caps for baseball players and how to make sure the average ball player also gets to have a payday. Listen wherever you get your podcasts (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
